0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000010_VOICEGUIDE
0.description: (-Allagan Console-)Biometric authentication complete. Please state your business.

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000020_VOICEGUIDE
1.description: (-Allagan Console-)Acknowledged. Reinitializing Syrcus Tower systems. Searching for “Elidibus” entity...

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000030_VOICEGUIDE
2.description: (-Allagan Console-)Target located in subterranean core power accumulator. Projecting image.

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000040_ELIDIBUS
3.description: My home... My friends... No more than a dream...

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000050_ELIDIBUS
4.description: You... Why have you awakened me?

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000060_ELIDIBUS
5.description: I no longer sense those places beyond...or Lord Zodiark. You must explain all.

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000070_ELIDIBUS
6.description: So. He is fallen, and my brethren's souls returned to the star...

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000080_ELIDIBUS
7.description: The doom we sacrificed so much to prevent is come again. Old burdens, now yours to bear.

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000090_ELIDIBUS
8.description: But...if this is Fandaniel's design, then I, as Elidibus, have a duty to fulfill.

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000100_ELIDIBUS
9.description: Your unsolicited act has restored to me some few memories of the Convocation.

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000110_ELIDIBUS
10.description: Such knowledge as I have, I will share.

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000120_ELIDIBUS
14.description: I do this not for you. I merely perform my duty, as I have ever done.

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000130_ELIDIBUS
15.description: Why apologize for receiving a favor of the defeated? If it sits ill, consider it payment for freeing Lord Zodiark from servitude.

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000140_ELIDIBUS
16.description: Where to begin... Ah. The end. Your understanding of what caused the Final Days is consistent with our own.

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000150_ELIDIBUS
17.description: The decay first took root where the currents were weakest. Yes...a conclusion drawn by him. Fandaniel.

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000160_ELIDIBUS
18.description: Not the him of here and now, but as I knew him. Long, long ago...

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000170_ELIDIBUS
19.description: Having shed light upon the phenomenon, he dedicated himself to devising a countermeasure.

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000180_ELIDIBUS
20.description: Were it not for his knowledge of the celestial, we would never have made the connection─and thence forestalled the Final Days.

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000190_ELIDIBUS
21.description: And though he inherited that noble soul...how different, this last incarnation. So consumed by self-loathing and hate.

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000200_ELIDIBUS
22.description: ...Elpis? Yes...the name is familiar to me.

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000210_ELIDIBUS
23.description: Yet I know it not as a flower, but a place.

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000220_ELIDIBUS
24.description: A testing facility for determining which of our creations were fit to be released into the world.

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000230_ELIDIBUS
25.description: Many worked there. And before joining the Convocation and assuming the title of Fandaniel, he was their chief...

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000260_ELIDIBUS
28.description: The crystals tell little of the lives the Fourteen led prior to their induction.

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000270_ELIDIBUS
29.description: Elpis itself would tell even less. Nary a ruin has survived─

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000280_ELIDIBUS
30.description: Wait... I saw you there. In Elpis.

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000290_ELIDIBUS
31.description: No...I did not...but I did. I did. A lingering trace of impossibility...

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000300_ELIDIBUS
32.description: And a truth...that fills my heart...

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000310_ELIDIBUS
33.description: My memories remain clouded, I fear. However...they have revealed to me one possible course.

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000320_ELIDIBUS
34.description: You must travel to Elpis─to the time when Hermes served as its chief.

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000330_ELIDIBUS
35.description: In glimpsing the Exarch's memories, not only did I make his summoning magick mine own─I also mastered the workings of this tower.

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000340_ELIDIBUS
36.description: Which, having absorbed my empowered essence, now harbors an abundance of energy.

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000350_ELIDIBUS
37.description: As such, I believe I can deliver you unto the past. Unto that place and that precise moment.

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000360_ELIDIBUS
38.description: Given the eons that must be traversed, the gateway will not be fully formed.

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000370_ELIDIBUS
39.description: Your form will be less tangible still than those Warriors of Light I had summoned.

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000380_ELIDIBUS
40.description: In all likelihood, none will be able to see or hear you.

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000390_ELIDIBUS
41.description: Yet even should you manage to interact with others, you will be unable to effect meaningful change.

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000400_ELIDIBUS
42.description: For the reality you wish to save─the reality to which you must return─exists as a result of the Final Days.

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000410_ELIDIBUS
43.description: You cannot reshape the past to undo the tragedies of the present. Cannot unmake the sorrow and suffering fated to come.

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000420_ELIDIBUS
44.description: In full knowledge of this, will you still entrust your life to your foe and make the journey?

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000430_ELIDIBUS
45.description: Very well. I shall cast you unto the river of time. Let this be my final act.

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000440_ELIDIBUS
46.description: You must input the commands. I no longer have the authority.

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000450_ELIDIBUS
47.description: First, you must reconfigure the systems, that the tower's aether may be channeled for the magick...

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000460_ELIDIBUS
48.description: The preparations are complete. The gateway will soon open. Return at once to the Ocular.

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000470_ELIDIBUS
49.description: All appears to be in order. The aether flows unimpeded.

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000480_ELIDIBUS
50.description: The magick should consume every last mote of my essence.

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000490_ELIDIBUS
51.description: Why are you surprised? Did I not say that this will be my final act?

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000500_ELIDIBUS
52.description: Lord Zodiark is no more. There is nothing for me here.

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000510_ELIDIBUS
53.description: The ones I love and long to see again are waiting. In that promised land, beyond memory and dream...

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000520_ELIDIBUS
54.description: Now go, Warrior of Light. Go...and do not look back.

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000530_ELIDIBUS
55.description: Well, Hydaelyn. I take my leave of You. Yours is the mantle of the last of us.

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000540_ELIDIBUS
56.description: May You have...the joy of it. The burden...and the solitude.

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000550_ELIDIBUS
57.description: It falls to You now─You and Your champion─to save our star.

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000570_PROPYLAIONSTAFF
59.description: Well, well, how rare to receive you in person. To what do we owe the honor?

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000580_HYTHLODAEUS
60.description: (-Familiar Stranger-)Oh, just a few odd tasks. We'll be here a while.

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000590_PROPYLAIONSTAFF
61.description: You're welcome to stay as long as you see fit, of course. As a matter of procedure, however, I must ask that you kindly remove your masks.

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000600_EMETSELCH
62.description: (-Familiar Voice-)Come now, is this truly necessary? Surely you can tell who we are...

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000610_HYTHLODAEUS
63.description: (-Familiar Stranger-)Who you are, perhaps, but I am far less infamous. Regardless, if we do not follow protocol, 'tis our hosts who would be held accountable. So please, do favor us with your handsome face.

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000640_PROPYLAIONSTAFF
66.description: I thank you for your cooperation. You are free to go about your business.

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000650_HYTHLODAEUS
67.description: (-Familiar Stranger-)By the by...you see it too, yes?

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000660_EMETSELCH
68.description: (-Man with a Familiar Voice-)I haven't the foggiest what you're talking about.

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000680_HYTHLODAEUS
70.description: (-Familiar Stranger-)It's right here. A bit thin in the aether, but there's no mistaking it─the color of its soul is almost identical to Azem's.

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000690_HYTHLODAEUS
71.description: (-Familiar Stranger-)Do you suppose he created it? Rather unusual for a familiar to have a soul, though...

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000700_HYTHLODAEUS
72.description: (-Familiar Stranger-)Do you suppose she created it? Rather unusual for a familiar to have a soul, though...

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000710_EMETSELCH
73.description: (-Man with a Familiar Voice-)Don't ask me. All I know is that it's trouble─doubly so if it's <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> spitting image.

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000720_EMETSELCH
74.description: (-Man with a Familiar Voice-)So let's leave it be. Come, now.

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000730_HYTHLODAEUS
75.description: (-Familiar Stranger-)It's trying to say something...but it's literally too intangible to form words.

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000740_HYTHLODAEUS
76.description: (-Familiar Stranger-)Why don't you give it some aether? Spare a snifter of your bounteous reserves.

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000750_EMETSELCH
77.description: (-Man with a Familiar Voice-)Who do you take me for?

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000760_HYTHLODAEUS
78.description: (-Familiar Stranger-)Why, a dear friend, of course! One who wouldn't let acts of kindness─such as my accompanying him on errands to far-flung outposts─go unrewarded.

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000780_EMETSELCH
80.description: (-Man with a Familiar Voice-)I suggest you close your eyes, or this may be...unpleasant.

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000790_EMETSELCH
81.description: (-Man with a Familiar Voice-)You may open your eyes.

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000800_HYTHLODAEUS
82.description: (-Familiar Stranger-)Still a touch small, don't you think?

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000810_EMETSELCH
83.description: (-Man with a Familiar Voice-)The size befits its proportions. Besides, bigger is not necessarily better.

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000820_HYTHLODAEUS
84.description: (-Familiar Stranger-)I will defer to your experience.

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000840_EMETSELCH
86.description: (-Man with a Familiar Voice-)The size befits its proportions. Though I personally wouldn't be averse to smaller.

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000850_HYTHLODAEUS
87.description: (-Familiar Stranger-)No, no, this will suffice, I'm sure.

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000860_HYTHLODAEUS
88.description: (-Familiar Stranger-)Oh, you even adjusted its size.

89.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000870_EMETSELCH
89.description: (-Man with a Familiar Voice-)The better to indulge your whim. This way it will be easier to communicate.

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000880_HYTHLODAEUS
90.description: (-Familiar Stranger-)How very thoughtful of you. And may I applaud your artful reinforcement.

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000890_HYTHLODAEUS
91.description: Without further ado, then... Greetings! I am Hythlodaeus, chief of the Bureau of the Architect.

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000900_HYTHLODAEUS
92.description: Sulking beside me is the most honorable Emet-Selch of the Convocation of Fourteen.

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000910_HYTHLODAEUS
93.description: And how might we address you, my new friend?

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000920_HYTHLODAEUS
94.description: A fine name. And I'm pleased to see you understand our words.

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000930_HYTHLODAEUS
95.description: So tell us, whence have you come? The thinness of your essence suggests you weren't created here...

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000940_HYTHLODAEUS
96.description: You do not know...or cannot say? Hmm. Allow me to ask a different question, then.

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_A2_000_001_NONE_VOICE
99.description: I seek a man named Hermes.

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_A2_000_002_NONE_VOICE
100.description: I want to learn about Elpis.

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000960_HYTHLODAEUS
101.description: Well now, the same as us...

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000970_HYTHLODAEUS
102.description: Perhaps Azem wished to come too, but had to settle for a familiar.

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_000980_EMETSELCH
103.description: If <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> truly wished to be here, then <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> would be.

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001000_HYTHLODAEUS
105.description: My apologies if we've given offense. The two of us can discern the color of souls, you see, and yours happens to resemble that of a friend.

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001010_HYTHLODAEUS
106.description: And with your purpose matching our own besides, we jumped to a hasty conclusion.

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001020_HYTHLODAEUS
107.description: We are here to speak with Hermes, the chief overseer of this facility, which we also intend to tour in order to gain greater insight into the man's work.

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001030_HYTHLODAEUS
108.description: “We,” I say, though this is Emet-Selch's charge. I am here only to serve as his guide.

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001040_HYTHLODAEUS
109.description: And I should be happy to serve as yours as well─by way of an apology for the misunderstanding.

110.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001050_EMETSELCH
110.description: Wait, are you suggesting that we bring it along on official business? This thing we know next to nothing about?

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001060_HYTHLODAEUS
111.description: If you harbor suspicions, better to keep it close than leave it to its own devices, wouldn't you agree?

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001070_HYTHLODAEUS
112.description: Besides, having a mysterious life-form in tow is the norm rather than the exception here.

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001080_HYTHLODAEUS
113.description: Welcome, my friends, to the testing ground of creation at heavens' edge: Elpis!

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001110_EMETSELCH
116.description: What secrets are you hiding, I wonder...

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001150_METEION
121.description: (-Bewinged Girl-)You and me. We're alike. Friends. I want to be─

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001170_METEION
123.description: (-Bewinged Girl-)Greetings and salutations! Can you hear me?

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001180_METEION
124.description: (-Bewinged Girl-)Do not be alarmed─I mean you no harm. I wish only to hear your words, share your feelings, and know your thoughts.

127.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001210_HYTHLODAEUS
127.description: Ah, I see you found him.

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001220_HERMES
128.description: Hythlodaeus... It's been a while. Too long, I think.

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001230_HYTHLODAEUS
129.description: Too long indeed for close collaborators. On this blessed occasion, I bring not only myself, but others who long to speak with you.

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001250_EMETSELCH
131.description: Emet-Selch, at your service. Do I have the honor of addressing Hermes, chief overseer of Elpis?

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001260_HERMES
132.description: You do. You have traveled far for it.

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001270_EMETSELCH
133.description: Given your facility's purpose, its remote location is something of a necessity. Would that I didn't have to rely upon a guide...

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001280_HYTHLODAEUS
134.description: You wound me. Have I not ever been an attentive and helpful friend?

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001290_HYTHLODAEUS
135.description: But moving along to more agreeable company, this one we chanced to...

136.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001300_HYTHLODAEUS
136.description: ...Well, you certainly have her attention. Is she one of yours, Hermes?

137.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001310_HERMES
137.description: Her name is Meteion. It means shooting star.

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001320_HYTHLODAEUS
138.description: If I may make an observation, her aether is terribly thin. I fear she might dissipate at any moment.

139.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001330_HYTHLODAEUS
139.description: Nor do I believe you've made a submission to the bureau. I would remember such a concept if you had.

140.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001340_HERMES
140.description: I haven't, as you say. I judged it too early. She's a pet project of mine─still undergoing preliminary testing.

141.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001350_HERMES
141.description: But rest assured that I will attend in person ere long.

142.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001360_HYTHLODAEUS
142.description: Very well. Being an authority on flying life-forms, I appreciate that you are exacting in your work.

143.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001370_HYTHLODAEUS
143.description: I shall look forward to your submission.

144.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001380_EMETSELCH
144.description: If we have finished with the perfunctory chitchat, I would discuss official matters.

145.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001390_EMETSELCH
145.description: By my coming, I trust you already anticipate the subject.

146.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001400_HERMES
146.description: I have an inkling, yes. Please wait at the main building yonder.

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001410_HERMES
147.description: I shall join you as soon as I've returned these creatures to their homes.

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001440_HYTHLODAEUS
151.description: Hm, I may have found it. A creature with the selfsame aether as those there, nestled in the boughs of a tree outside the grounds.

152.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001450_EMETSELCH
152.description: You're saying they can climb? With their sorry excuses for limbs?

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001460_HERMES
153.description: The “fashion” has been to imbue aquatic creatures with the power of flight, ever since the Words of Mitron created a sky-swimming fish...

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001470_HERMES
154.description: The ambystomas too can fly, if only slightly, and they could conceivably climb a tree. Whether they can come down safely, however... Excuse me.

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001490_EMETSELCH
156.description: And what are we supposed to do with this lot?

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001500_HYTHLODAEUS
157.description: May I suggest we split up?

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001510_HYTHLODAEUS
158.description: If you would be so good as to assist Hermes, Emet-Selch and I shall keep an eye on these adorable creations in the meantime.

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001520_EMETSELCH
159.description: This appears to be the place.

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001530_EMETSELCH
160.description: And here is where we part ways.

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001540_EMETSELCH
161.description: We will be discussing highly sensitive affairs. Only a select few may be privy to such knowledge, and that does not include someone who cannot or will not divulge their origins.

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001550_EMETSELCH
162.description: What? Will I have to remove you by force?

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_A3_000_001_NONE_VOICE
164.description: I have important things to say to him as well.

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_A3_000_002_NONE_VOICE
165.description: There are reasons I cannot speak freely.

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001560_EMETSELCH
166.description: Yes, I'm sure your business with Hermes is quite pressing. You may speak with him to your heart's content─after ours is concluded.

167.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001570_EMETSELCH
167.description: Let's hear them, then. These reasons of yours. Who knows─if I deem your mysterious cause worthy, I may even be inclined to offer my assistance.

168.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001580_HERMES
168.description: I do not object to his attendance.

169.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001590_HERMES
169.description: I do not object to her attendance.

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001610_HERMES
171.description: Perhaps, but I believe <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> can be trusted. Meteion would not have taken to <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03> so quickly otherwise.

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001620_HERMES
172.description: Moreover...the presence of a third party may help me to maintain composure.

177.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001670_EMETSELCH
177.description: Aye. Fandaniel has declared his intention to step down, and named you as his preferred successor.

178.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001680_EMETSELCH
178.description: In recognition of your knowledge and your works, the Convocation is giving the recommendation due consideration.

179.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001690_EMETSELCH
179.description: As one who does not know you personally, I am to use my impartial eye to take your measure.

180.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001700_EMETSELCH
180.description: And above all else, to ascertain your disposition towards the invitation.

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001710_EMETSELCH
181.description: I understand that you and Fandaniel are close. He himself was once chief overseer of Elpis, after all.

182.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001720_EMETSELCH
182.description: I should not be surprised if you knew before anyone else that he wished to relinquish his office.

183.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001730_HERMES
183.description: I did... He told me that, when he fulfilled his purpose, he wished to pass the torch to me.

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001740_EMETSELCH
184.description: A torch you seem none too pleased to accept. Are you so averse to serving on the Convocation?

186.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001760_HERMES
186.description: For a humble researcher like myself to even be considered...is an honor beyond words.

187.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001770_HERMES
187.description: No, what troubles me─what I struggle to come to terms with─is the very fact that Fandaniel is stepping down.

188.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001780_HERMES
188.description: Does this not mean that he will return to the star?

189.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001790_EMETSELCH
189.description: Of his own volition, yes. Like so many others have before him.

190.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001800_METEION
190.description: Return to the star? Does that mean...die?

191.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001810_HYTHLODAEUS
191.description: Well now, that's not a word I hear often... Is that what you say here in Elpis?

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001820_HYTHLODAEUS
192.description: Mankind is the life of Etheirys. Each of us a drop of blood flowing through its veins, bearing sustenance.

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001830_HYTHLODAEUS
193.description: In our finite time upon it, 'tis our duty to make it a better place, that all who call it home now and in future may abide in happiness.

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001840_HYTHLODAEUS
194.description: To that end, we have dedicated ourselves to the pursuit of enlightened creation. And by our efforts did we transform this once-untamed wilderness into the peaceful paradise you enjoy today.

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001850_HYTHLODAEUS
195.description: To return to the star whence we came is a privilege afforded to we who have so loved and nurtured it.

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001860_HYTHLODAEUS
196.description: A choice embraced by those who have lived their lives to the fullest, in service to our world.

197.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001870_HYTHLODAEUS
197.description: And when they depart upon this journey, it is beautiful. Always.

198.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001880_EMETSELCH
198.description: The Fourteen are no exception. 'Tis believed no occasion is more felicitous than the fulfillment of one's duty.

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001890_EMETSELCH
199.description: Our office becomes our lives, and to retire is to return. Or so the majority of us hold. Some few have elected to eschew custom.

200.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001900_EMETSELCH
200.description: Mayhap you feel Fandaniel's deeds do not warrant his return.

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001910_EMETSELCH
201.description: Yet you should know his accomplishments as well as any. During his time, he conceived of countless outstanding concepts.

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001920_EMETSELCH
202.description: And channeling the wealth of experience he attained here in Elpis, he brought forth many new specimens.

203.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001930_HERMES
203.description: I know of all this, I do...

204.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001940_HERMES
204.description: It's just...I cannot fathom why someone so great and wise, who could still do so much good, would want to end it all...

205.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001950_HERMES
205.description: Oh no, I've made her upset...

206.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001960_HERMES
206.description: Forgive me─I know I requested your presence. Might I trouble you to take Meteion outside? A change of scenery would do her good.

207.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001970_HERMES
207.description: Amazing, is it not? The ampelos─one of our newest subjects.

208.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001980_HERMES
208.description: So, how are we coming along?

209.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_001990_METEION
209.description: This place is Elpis! Those flowers, Elpis!

211.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002010_HERMES
211.description: They are a product of Elpis and so named for their birthplace.

212.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002020_HERMES
212.description: A happy accident born of the hands of a former researcher who loved beautiful blossoms.

213.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002030_HERMES
213.description: Unique for how they change color to reflect the emotional state of those nearby.

214.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002040_HERMES
214.description: Though be it here or elsewhere, they are seldom seen in any hue save purest white...

215.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002050_HYTHLODAEUS
215.description: Reflect the emotional state, you say? By what means do they achieve this?

216.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002060_HERMES
216.description: In creation, there exists an energy wholly apart from aether. One driven by emotions.

217.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002070_HERMES
217.description: In like manner to how we manipulate aether, this flower is subject to the influence of said energy.

218.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002080_HERMES
218.description: While it has no will of its own, it is sensitive to the prevailing emotion in the vicinity, and reacts by altering its color and vibrancy.

219.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002090_NIDHANA
219.description: (-Nidhana-)Akasa? It is one of the unseen energies defined by Hannish alchemical theory. Though a gross oversimplification, some describe it as an essence influenced by feelings.

220.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002100_HERMES
220.description: Akasa... Though I'm not familiar with the term, your description suggests it is the selfsame energy.

222.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002120_HERMES
222.description: And those entities like the Elpis flower, that have the ability to interact with this energy, converting emotions into tangible phenomena...

224.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002140_METEION
224.description: That's me, that's me! An entelechy!

225.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002150_HERMES
225.description: That you are, my dear. And no ordinary one at that, but the first possessed of free will.

226.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002160_EMETSELCH
226.description: Wait. A form of energy other than aether? Dynamis?

227.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002170_EMETSELCH
227.description: I've never heard of such a thing.

228.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002180_HERMES
228.description: Hardly surprising. Dynamis cannot be seen, much less felt.

229.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002190_HERMES
229.description: And though its existence has long been theorized, we had no proof until the flower's serendipitous creation.

230.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002200_HERMES
230.description: What's more, dynamis is far weaker than aether. Under normal circumstances, its effects are drowned out by the latter.

231.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002210_HERMES
231.description: On account of which, beings comprised of and reliant upon aether, like you and I, are unable to make practical use of dynamis.

232.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002220_HERMES
232.description: 'Tis a truly esoteric thing, known to but a select few scholars.

233.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002230_EMETSELCH
233.description: Intriguing... Then given the limitations you described, why create Meteion?

234.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002240_HERMES
234.description: Our star, Etheirys, is especially rich in aether. So much so that its name is derived from it.

235.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002250_HERMES
235.description: However, when we consider all energy in existence, here and in the vast space beyond, dynamis may account for as much as sixty-eight point three percent.

236.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002260_HERMES
236.description: The more abundant form by far. Were we able to control it, we could open the door to limitless possibilities.

237.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002270_HERMES
237.description: 'Tis not unlike a gently flowing stream, unable to break through the dam of aether barring its path. But if we could imbue this stream with the vigor of a raging river...

238.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002280_HERMES
238.description: ...Not that I have such grand ambitions.

239.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002290_HERMES
239.description: Nay, I merely wished to create a being that could traverse the great expanse.

240.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002300_HERMES
240.description: The relative scarcity of aether beyond the bounds of this star was a concern, and so I looked to another source of energy by necessity.

241.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002310_HYTHLODAEUS
241.description: That being dynamis. No wonder her aether is so thin.

243.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002330_METEION
243.description: Yours is thin too. Like an entelechy. Like me.

246.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_A4_000_001_NONE_VOICE
246.description: Sure, I don't see why I couldn't be one.

247.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_A4_000_002_NONE_VOICE
247.description: Well, I <hex:021A020203>have<hex:021A020103> been known to transcend my limits with nothing but determination.

248.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_A4_000_003_NONE_VOICE
248.description: If I'm thin, it's because Emet-Selch didn't do a proper job.

249.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002350_EMETSELCH
249.description: I think not. Your nature remains a mystery, but ere I reinforced you, you appeared to be little more than a common familiar─and a faded one at that.

250.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002360_EMETSELCH
250.description: That sounds more akin to the desperate flailings of a wild beast when facing imminent death.

251.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002370_EMETSELCH
251.description: Well, aren't we ungrateful? Mayhap I should revert you to the pathetic, faded thing you were.

252.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002380_HERMES
252.description: A deficit of aether alone does not an entelechy make. It would, however, make it easier for you to interact with dynamis.

253.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002390_HERMES
253.description: And limited though its influence may be, this quality could prove the difference between victory and defeat. You'd do well not to underestimate it.

254.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002400_HERMES
254.description: Oh dear, I'd forgotten about the poor fellow. You must excuse me a moment while I go and verify a few more things.

255.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002410_EMETSELCH
255.description: No, no, no, you are not foisting this nonsense on me!

256.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002420_HERMES
256.description: I'm given to understand you have the power to help the charybdis─and should be quite willing to do so.

257.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002430_HERMES
257.description: And so I appeal to your better nature, most benevolent Emet-Selch. Please teach it to fly!

258.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002440_METEION
258.description: Or else Hermes will transform! Right now!

259.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002450_HYTHLODAEUS
259.description: Now, now, there's no need to go quite that far. Altruism is its own reward, as I'm sure he would agree.

260.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002460_EMETSELCH
260.description: Oh would he now? And who contrived to put me in this position, pray tell?

261.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002470_HYTHLODAEUS
261.description: Nothing so devious. I merely suggested a possible course of action.

264.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002500_EMETSELCH
264.description: I did not come all this way to play nursemaid to your creations. I'd thank you to remember this favor...and let it be the last.

265.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002510_EMETSELCH
265.description: I will aid it once it has taken to the air. It falls to you to shepherd it skyward.

266.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002520_HYTHLODAEUS
266.description: Well, let's relax and enjoy the spectacle, shall we?

267.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002530_HYTHLODAEUS
267.description: You were wondering why Emet-Selch joined the Convocation.

268.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002540_HYTHLODAEUS
268.description: Truth be told, he wasn't the first choice for the office. I was─on the strength of my ability to see aether.

269.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002550_HYTHLODAEUS
269.description: But I declined the offer. For though my vision is exceptional, I am pedestrian in all other aspects. Worse, even.

270.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002560_HYTHLODAEUS
270.description: Quite abysmal when it comes to manipulating aether, for example. Couldn't transform even if I had a mind to do so.

271.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002570_HYTHLODAEUS
271.description: What good is the ability to perceive a problem if one cannot act to address it?

272.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002580_HYTHLODAEUS
272.description: Emet-Selch has no such shortcomings. He excels in vision and manipulation both─the latter to an extraordinary degree.

273.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002590_HYTHLODAEUS
273.description: If there is a mage more powerful, I do not know of them.

274.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002600_HYTHLODAEUS
274.description: Thus did I recommend him for the office in my stead. And I wasn't the only one. Far from it.

275.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002610_HYTHLODAEUS
275.description: Countless others vouched for his skill and character. People the world over, to whom he had previously lent a helping hand.

276.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002620_HYTHLODAEUS
276.description: Oh, how surprised he was. Claimed he hadn't done anything remarkable for anyone. Modest to a fault.

277.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002630_HYTHLODAEUS
277.description: He deserved every bit of acclaim he received. Yet he may well have gone unappreciated were it not for a mutual friend.

278.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002640_HYTHLODAEUS
278.description: A singular soul who can't help but involve <hex:020815E905FF0868657273656C66FF0868696D73656C6603> in the business of others. Where <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> walks, excitement is certain to follow.

279.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002650_HYTHLODAEUS
279.description: <hex:02080DE905FF04486572FF0448697303> antics irritate Emet-Selch to no end, but much of his grumbling stems from genuine concern.

280.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002660_HYTHLODAEUS
280.description: When our friend calls, he never fails to answer and lend his talents.

281.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002670_HYTHLODAEUS
281.description: And in the course of doing so, he himself came to be recognized and respected by those around him.

282.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002680_HYTHLODAEUS
282.description: They are truly remarkable individuals, and I'm proud to call them friends.

283.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002690_HYTHLODAEUS
283.description: To help them realize their dreams─this will be my greatest contribution to our world.

284.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002700_HYTHLODAEUS
284.description: And when they have fulfilled their respective purposes...

285.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002710_HYTHLODAEUS
285.description: So too shall I have fulfilled mine, and together we may return to the star.

286.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002720_HYTHLODAEUS
286.description: Look at me, spilling my innermost secrets. I can't seem to help it with you.

287.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002730_HYTHLODAEUS
287.description: I can only assume it is due to the color of your soul. I just don't understand how you can be so alike and yet so different.

288.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002740_METEION
288.description: Well done, my pet! Well done!

289.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002750_HYTHLODAEUS
289.description: Ah yes, I daresay the charybdis will be fine hereon.

290.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002760_HYTHLODAEUS
290.description: Why don't you go and signal to Emet-Selch. Let him know that his arduous task is at an end.

292.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002780_HERMES
292.description: Oh... You were waiting for me.

294.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002800_HERMES
294.description: Yes. We've come to a decision.

295.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002810_HERMES
295.description: My thanks for keeping Meteion company.

296.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002820_HERMES
296.description: Emet-Selch and Hythlodaeus have already retired to their rooms.

297.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002830_HERMES
297.description: There is a room for you too, if you would follow me.

298.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002840_METEION
298.description: Wait! I want to show you something first.

302.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002880_METEION
302.description: You're not the only one, Hermes. Others feel sad too. You're not alone.

303.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002890_HERMES
303.description: I see Meteion has shared much with you.

305.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002910_HERMES
305.description: I do not think it wrong that we live for the star. That we strive to make it a better place.

306.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002920_HERMES
306.description: And yet, in carrying out my duties here, there are times when I am plagued by doubt.

307.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002930_HERMES
307.description: Do you recall what Hythlodaeus said, when we first spoke of my nomination?

308.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002940_HERMES
308.description: Death is the privilege of those who have fulfilled their purpose. A choice they embrace of their own free will. And when they depart, it is always beautiful.

309.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002950_HERMES
309.description: Perhaps it is...but only for man.

310.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002960_HERMES
310.description: Creations that he deems useless are discarded with nary a second thought.

311.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002970_HERMES
311.description: Some scarcely born into the world. Afforded a handful of breaths before life and potential are abruptly extinguished.

312.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002980_HERMES
312.description: We make an effort to spare them the pain. But they sense what awaits. Rage in anguish and cower in fear...and it is <hex:021A020203>not<hex:021A020103> beautiful.

313.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_002990_HERMES
313.description: Yet no one cares. No one.

314.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003000_HERMES
314.description: So fixated are we upon the duty that we do not pause to question the method.

315.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003010_HERMES
315.description: Pain and suffering... Confusion and despair... Writ plain in the eyes of those poor creatures.

316.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003020_HERMES
316.description: Yet no one sees. We turn a blind eye and carry on in blissful ignorance. Naught amiss, and always─always the blossoms shine pure and white.

317.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003030_HERMES
317.description: A contradiction so blatant I could scream. Want to scream. How can you all accept this...aberration!?

318.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003040_HERMES
318.description: Then I wonder...am <hex:021A020203>I<hex:021A020103> the aberration for thinking thus? And I am filled with dread...

319.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003050_HERMES
319.description: But now I know I'm not alone. Not the only one for whom the flowers weep.

320.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003060_HERMES
320.description: I won't ask what you thought as you kneeled beside the Elpis. Or if you only did it at Meteion's insistence.

322.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003080_HERMES
322.description: To know that you too have experienced suffering...is a comfort.

324.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_A5_000_001_NONE_VOICE
324.description: Glad I could be of service.

325.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_A5_000_002_NONE_VOICE
325.description: Let's have no more brooding, eh?

326.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_A5_000_003_NONE_VOICE
326.description: Oh, I could tell you <hex:021A020203>all<hex:021A020103> about suffering.

327.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003090_HERMES
327.description: To so willingly lend an ear to ease my burden... You are a strange one.

328.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003100_HERMES
328.description: ...Indeed. Difficult though it may be, I must endeavor to be strong like you.

329.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003110_HERMES
329.description: Lest you misunderstand, I derive no pleasure from your pain.

330.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003120_HERMES
330.description: It's just...the fact that you are still here, in spite of your suffering, gives me heart.

331.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003130_HERMES
331.description: The stars in the heavens... Know you what they are?

332.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003140_HERMES
332.description: Though it is too far to tell, each glittering light could be a world not unlike Etheirys. A world filled with life.

333.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003150_HERMES
333.description: So many stars, so many lives... For us, there may be no higher purpose than to live for our world, but what of the other living beings out there?

334.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003160_HERMES
334.description: What is it that gives <hex:021A020203>their<hex:021A020103> lives meaning? That drives them day after day after day?

335.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003170_HERMES
335.description: To pose that question to our undiscovered cousins, I created beings of dynamis, who can traverse the vast emptiness between the stars. Meteion and her sisters.

337.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003190_HERMES
337.description: She has a great many of them, and they have already departed on their journey. Traveling to one star, and then the next, in search of life.

338.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003200_HERMES
338.description: As one might expect, exploration on such a grand scale is rife with difficulties, and thus far I've naught to show for it.

339.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003210_HERMES
339.description: But I have faith that we will make some manner of discovery ere long.

340.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003220_HERMES
340.description: And when we do, I should be glad to share our findings with you, in gratitude for your kindness.

341.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003230_HERMES
341.description: ...It's getting rather late. We had best find our beds. 'Twould not do for both of us to be sleep-deprived on the morrow.

342.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003240_HERMES
342.description: Come, Meteion! Let us head back.

347.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003290_HERMES
347.description: May you and your kin find peace...

348.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003300_HERMES
348.description: Wherever your souls may drift in the Underworld, may you find tranquil seas.

349.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003310_HERMES
349.description: Be not forgotten. In concept endure to reclaim form and one day live again.

350.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003320_HERMES
350.description: Serve not the star or any purpose save your own. Live again, if that be your desire.

351.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003330_HERMES
351.description: Hate, if that be your wont. We are worthy. But leave your suffering behind.

352.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003340_HERMES
352.description: Lay down your burdens. Be born anew. Fly high. Fly free.

355.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003370_HERMES
355.description: Leave to replace another─to be replaced? It changes nothing!

356.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003380_HERMES
356.description: Tell me! Do you think it right that we sacrifice all these lives for the sake of the star?

357.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003390_HERMES
357.description: And when the star has reached perfection─what then? If all who are satisfied choose to die, shall we all die in satisfaction!?

359.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003410_HERMES
359.description: Were I to take up the seat of Fandaniel, it would be tantamount to approving my predecessor's death.

360.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003420_HERMES
360.description: I do not know if it is right.

361.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003430_HERMES
361.description: And to be torn by such thoughts...I do not know if I am fit to represent mankind.

363.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003450_METEION
363.description: Please don't be angry... It hurts so...

365.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003470_HERMES
365.description: If you would still consider me in spite of everything, I beg some time to gather my thoughts.

366.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003480_HERMES
366.description: Meanwhile, Hythlodaeus, I fear I must trouble you to attend to the others.

367.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003490_HYTHLODAEUS
367.description: 'Tis no trouble at all. Take as long as you require.

368.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003500_HERMES
368.description: And you, my friend. I pray you find that which you seek.

369.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003510_HYTHLODAEUS
369.description: I expect we have some few matters to discuss. Shall we return to the Twelve Wonders for a time?

371.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003530_HYTHLODAEUS
371.description: I present to you Kallimelios Zephyros.

372.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003540_HYTHLODAEUS
372.description: Here you will find a number of testing facilities as well as the observation hub of Poieten Oikos.

374.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003560_HYTHLODAEUS
374.description: Well, well, an oreias. How delightful.

375.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003570_EMETSELCH
375.description: And what, pray tell, is that...?

376.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003580_HYTHLODAEUS
376.description: Ah, that's a new species of shark. We approved the concept but a few days ago.

377.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003590_HYTHLODAEUS
377.description: Sharks are among the most popular sea creatures. Rare is the day when someone does not submit a new concept.

378.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003600_HYTHLODAEUS
378.description: At first, they were largely orthodox. Consideration given to such things as size and environmental impact. And then a whimsical someone thought to bestow it with flight. Another, superior intelligence. And then the floodgates burst. Concepts with multiple heads, or arms, or legs, or arms <hex:021A020203>and<hex:021A020103> legs...and so on and so forth. It was getting absurd. A part of me wanted to tell them to go away and find something else to create, but in the end, I couldn't deny their passion...and here we are.

381.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003630_VENAS
381.description: (-Familiar Woman-)That was too close... Are you unharmed?

382.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003640_VENAS
382.description: (-Familiar Woman-)Well now, if it isn't a pair of familiar faces...

383.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003650_HYTHLODAEUS
383.description: Venat! That we should meet you here!

384.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003660_EMETSELCH
384.description: As I mentioned earlier, the better part of the Convocation holds that when we retire is when we return to the star.

385.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003670_EMETSELCH
385.description: Well, she is not among said majority. Even after stepping down, she carries on with her work.

386.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003680_EMETSELCH
386.description: Venat is her name, and she is the previous Azem.

387.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003690_VENAS
387.description: It has been a while, Hythlodaeus. You look well.

388.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003700_VENAS
388.description: Less so, Emet-Selch. I daresay the lines upon your brow have both deepened and doubled in number.

389.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003710_VENAS
389.description: A shame for one so young. You must make an effort to frown less often.

390.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003720_EMETSELCH
390.description: Easier said than done thanks to your unruly successor.

391.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003730_VENAS
391.description: How is <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503>, if I may ask?

392.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003740_HYTHLODAEUS
392.description: Incorrigible as ever. Rushed headlong into a volcano on the brink of eruption just the other day. I should be glad to share the tale in its entirety later, if you are so inclined.

395.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003770_VENAS
395.description: I say...have you perchance come from the future?

396.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003775_VENAS
396.description: I do not believe we have ever met, yet I sense my magick upon you.

397.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003776_VENAS
397.description: Therefore if I wove the enchantment, I could only have done so at a later point in time.

398.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003780_HYTHLODAEUS
398.description: What manner of magick is this, if I may ask?

399.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003790_VENAS
399.description: A traveler's ward, of course. It prevents the corruption of one's aether.

401.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_A5_000_004_NONE_VOICE
401.description: That sounds rather like the blessing of Light...

402.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_A5_000_005_NONE_VOICE
402.description: Does it protect you from enthrallment by primals, by any chance?

403.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003800_VENAS
403.description: I see you are not ignorant to its presence. And while there are many protective spells, the one you bear is unmistakably mine.

404.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003805_VENAS
404.description: ...Primals, you say? I'm not familiar with such beings, but if they “enthrall” by warping the balance of aether, then yes─the magick would afford you a measure of protection.

405.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003806_VENAS
405.description: I gather from your question that you are not ignorant to its presence.

406.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003810_EMETSELCH
406.description: Hold on─from the future? That's absurd.

407.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003820_VENAS
407.description: What is it? Are you unable to speak of the matter?

408.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003830_ELIDIBUS
408.description: The reality to which you must return exists as a result of the Final Days.

409.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003840_ELIDIBUS
409.description: You cannot reshape the past to undo the tragedies of the present.

410.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003850_VENAS
410.description: So, your actions here will not change your history...but they may yet affect the course of ours...

411.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003860_VENAS
411.description: How very exciting. I'm quite fond of delving into the unknown─and there's naught more unknown than the future.

412.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003870_VENAS
412.description: Until a moment finally arrives, we cannot know for certain what will come to pass─regardless of our supposed foreknowledge. So you needn't worry for us.

413.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003880_VENAS
413.description: More importantly, that you should go to such great lengths as to travel unto the past bespeaks the gravity of your quest.

414.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003890_VENAS
414.description: Will you not reveal it to us? Mayhap we can be of aid to your cause.

416.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003910_EMETSELCH
416.description: If this is true, then you've been keeping quite the secret to yourself.

417.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003920_EMETSELCH
417.description: As a representative of the Convocation, I will hear it all. Your identity, purpose─everything.

418.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003930_VENAS
418.description: Why don't we move to a place more conducive to calm conversation.

419.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003940_VENAS
419.description: I've been working here for some days now at an old friend's behest.

420.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003950_VENAS
420.description: If it is agreeable, we may make use of my accommodation at Poieten Oikos.

421.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003960_VENAS
421.description: We were meant to meet, I am certain of it.

422.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003970_VENAS
422.description: Else I wouldn't have marked you so clearly and sent you unto myself in the past.

423.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003980_VENAS
423.description: It's precisely the sort of mischief I would get up to─and quite inspired, if I do say so myself.

424.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_003990_HYTHLODAEUS
424.description: A wonderful aroma... I feel more relaxed already.

425.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004000_VENAS
425.description: Would that I had sweetmeats to offer, but I travel light out of habit.

426.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004010_VENAS
426.description: There's plenty of hot water, though, so please have as much tea as you like.

427.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004020_VENAS
427.description: Now then...will you tell us your tale?

428.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_Q6_000_001_NONE_VOICE
428.description: In the future I came from...

429.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_A6_000_001_NONE_VOICE
429.description: A calamity called the Final Days has befallen the world.

430.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_A6_000_002_NONE_VOICE
430.description: The world has been sundered...broken into shards.

431.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_A6_000_003_NONE_VOICE
431.description: Mankind is being forced to flee the star.

432.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004030_EMETSELCH
432.description: Why don't you start from the beginning?

434.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004050_HYTHLODAEUS
434.description: While not the words I would have chosen, I too have my doubts. Much of it borders on the incredulous.

436.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004070_VENAS
436.description: Not knowing the precise details of the first Final Days, 'tis difficult to determine the veracity of the tale.

437.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004080_VENAS
437.description: Supposing it is all true, I must ask myself why I would do what I did.

438.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004090_VENAS
438.description: Why would I feel I had no recourse but to oppose the Fourteen and create this Hydaelyn...

439.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004100_VENAS
439.description: Circumstances change, of course, but it would not have been an easy decision regardless.

440.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004110_VENAS
440.description: No, there must have been a reason. One compelling enough to force me to take such drastic measures.

441.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004120_VENAS
441.description: Then there is the Elpis flower, which I said would serve as a guide.

442.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004130_VENAS
442.description: That it's of import to your mission is plain, but your presence here leads me to believe that this place also holds significance.

443.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004140_VENAS
443.description: But what could it be? What are we meant to accomplish?

444.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004150_HYTHLODAEUS
444.description: Might it not be simply thus?

445.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004160_HYTHLODAEUS
445.description: In the future whence he came, the Final Days could not be averted. Mankind has no choice but to flee the star.

446.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004170_HYTHLODAEUS
446.description: In the future whence she came, the Final Days could not be averted. Mankind has no choice but to flee the star.

447.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004180_HYTHLODAEUS
447.description: By alerting us to that eventuality, perhaps you wished to pave the way for other futures.

448.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004190_VENAS
448.description: Theoretically speaking, it is a possibility.

449.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004200_VENAS
449.description: Yet if that were my primary objective, I see no reason to guide our friend to Elpis specifically.

450.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004210_VENAS
450.description: The Capitol in Amaurot, or even my own home would be more logical destinations.

451.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004220_HYTHLODAEUS
451.description: True, true... I note also that Hydaelyn did not specify a point in time to which he must return.

452.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004230_HYTHLODAEUS
452.description: True, true... I note also that Hydaelyn did not specify a point in time to which she must return.

453.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004240_HYTHLODAEUS
453.description: By this, it may be inferred that it was not critical that we should meet.

454.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004250_VENAS
454.description: Alternately, She had reason to believe that our paths would converge, coincidental though it may seem.

455.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004260_HYTHLODAEUS
455.description: This is quite a puzzle, and we do not have all the pieces...

456.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004270_VENAS
456.description: Hardly any. But we do have one immutable fact.

457.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004280_VENAS
457.description: If the Final Days are indeed as described, they will bring death to all that I hold dear.

458.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004290_VENAS
458.description: Yet despite being afforded long years of preparation, the only provisions I could make were...for flight?

459.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004300_VENAS
459.description: Nay, my first and foremost endeavor would be to find a way to forestall the coming doom.

460.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004310_HYTHLODAEUS
460.description: Given that even the Fourteen failed, mayhap you deemed it impossible.

461.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004320_VENAS
461.description: Nothing is impossible. This, I have always believed.

462.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004330_VENAS
462.description: And if Hydaelyn is indeed me, She would believe the same.

463.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004340_EMETSELCH
463.description: Listen to yourself. Are you seriously entertaining the notion that you are a messianic figure in some far-fetched tale?

464.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004350_EMETSELCH
464.description: Well, I will not. I refuse to accept that our world could be undone by some unforeseen calamity.

465.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004360_EMETSELCH
465.description: I also take offense to my portrayal as a megalomaniacal madman.

466.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004370_EMETSELCH
466.description: To sacrifice oneself for the star is a noble act, and I would hold those who gave themselves to this Zodiark in the highest esteem.

467.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004380_EMETSELCH
467.description: Yet you claim I recreated Amaurot and populated it with phantoms of our people. A bizarre indulgence that would be insulting to their memory.

468.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004390_EMETSELCH
468.description: Worse still, I even <hex:021A020203>invited<hex:021A020103> you there─literally invited my own downfall. Why would I do something so idiotic and inexplicable?

469.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004400_EMETSELCH
469.description: Now, I will allow that the hypothetical task of restoring our world would be daunting in the extreme. The thought of having to bear such a burden for a thousand <hex:021A020203>thousand<hex:021A020103> lives horrifies me.

470.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004410_EMETSELCH
470.description: But I would never forsake my duty! I would never forsake my brethren!

472.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004430_EMETSELCH
472.description: I've had my fill of your fiction. I will return to my duty...and you will not bother me again.

474.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004450_VENAS
474.description: You've seen much of Elpis already. If you have any observations to share, I should like to hear them.

476.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_A7_000_001_NONE_VOICE
476.description: Dynamis is key to all of this.

477.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_A7_000_002_NONE_VOICE
477.description: Hermes and Meteion are somehow involved.

478.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_A7_000_003_NONE_VOICE
478.description: I'm still trying to make sense of it all...

479.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004460_VENAS
479.description: Ah yes, the energy distinct from aether. Though not my field, I have a basic understanding of dynamis.

480.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004470_VENAS
480.description: And you say Hermes researched the phenomenon in the course of creating Meteion... Yes, I believe this warrants further investigation.

481.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004480_VENAS
481.description: Hermes and his creation Meteion, you say?

482.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004490_VENAS
482.description: If dynamis is the selfsame energy as akasa, as it likely seems, then those two may well be at the center of the calamity to come. This warrants further investigation.

483.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004500_VENAS
483.description: I see. Then for now, it might be best that we follow your lead and investigate he who will become Fandaniel.

484.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004510_VENAS
484.description: And if dynamis is the selfsame energy as akasa, as it likely seems, we would do well to learn more about it.

485.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004520_VENAS
485.description: With that settled, 'tis time for action.

486.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004530_VENAS
486.description: The missing pieces of the puzzle are here, I'm certain of it. And when you find them, the picture my future self has painted will be complete, and you will have your answer.

487.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004540_VENAS
487.description: Suffice it to say I will aid you in your quest.

488.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004550_VENAS
488.description: Have faith. If Emet-Selch is the man Azem described to me, we've not seen the last of him.

489.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004560_VENAS
489.description: A delightful breeze...and a breathtaking view.

490.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004570_VENAS
490.description: What is it like in the future? Is the world still a beautiful place?

493.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_A8_000_002_NONE_VOICE
493.description: Some parts, yes. Others...not so much.

495.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004580_VENAS
495.description: I swear, I could hear the glimmer in your eyes. And the adoration in your voice.

496.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004590_VENAS
496.description: Dark, hidden places, rife with danger? Those have an altogether different but no less powerful sort of appeal.

497.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004600_VENAS
497.description: Elpis is a place of exceptional beauty in this age, so it may not make for a fair comparison.

498.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004610_VENAS
498.description: While we wait, will you not tell me about your adventures?

499.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004620_VENAS
499.description: Not the portentous events which led you here, but the simple delights all your own.

500.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004630_VENAS
500.description: By learning about the future world, I may gain insight into future me's plans.

501.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004640_VENAS
501.description: But more than that, I have an interest simply as a fellow traveler. Short of going somewhere oneself, there's naught more stirring than hearing another's account.

502.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004650_VENAS
502.description: Incredible! Would that I could have been there to see it!

504.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004670_VENAS
504.description: Yours is a harsh and unforgiving world. Yet in spite of this, your brethren hold fast to their virtue.

505.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004680_VENAS
505.description: To know that the light of mankind's potential still shines, even in that faraway place... It gives me heart.

506.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004690_VENAS
506.description: Thank you for regaling me with your tales. I will treasure every word.

507.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004700_VENAS
507.description: As you know, I was once a scholar. And among other things, I sought to understand the workings of the world.

508.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004710_VENAS
508.description: What exactly is aether? How formed the laws of nature? Whence sprung mankind?

509.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004720_VENAS
509.description: Riddles and mysteries beyond counting. Over the years I have managed to find answers to some few of them...

510.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004730_VENAS
510.description: Yet rather than attain a sense of mastery, the more I understood, the more I came to hold the world and its miracles in awe.

511.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004740_VENAS
511.description: We too are miracles, each and every one of us. Born of the warm breath of life that traverses the heavens, swirling through eternity.

512.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004750_VENAS
512.description: When I fully grasped the improbability of our existence, nothing felt impossible any more. If it could be imagined, it could be done.

513.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004760_VENAS
513.description: A passion swelled within me. An epiphany dispelling all preconceptions of what was natural and true.

514.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004770_VENAS
514.description: And a presence without. Immense yet intimate─fate, perhaps─holding us in its tender embrace...

515.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004780_VENAS
515.description: As reassuring as it was intimidating. How keenly aware I became of creation's fragility, built as it is upon precarious happenstance.

516.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004790_VENAS
516.description: I was overcome with an irrepressible urge to know the world more intimately. To hear its voice, feel its breath...

517.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004800_VENAS
517.description: I ventured forth on a journey that very day. So very long ago now.

518.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004810_VENAS
518.description: Freed from presumption and prejudice, I saw the world through a newborn's eyes. Everything fresh and new and so, so beautiful.

519.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004820_VENAS
519.description: Lands that stretched on forever. Skies one could drown in. The heartbeat of nature, silent yet strong.

520.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004830_VENAS
520.description: And amidst it all a people. Beacons of light and life. Laughter that warmed my heart like naught else before.

521.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004840_VENAS
521.description: They are my meaning and my purpose. My love.

522.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004850_VENAS
522.description: And so long as they need help, I cannot return to the star.

523.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004860_VENAS
523.description: Perhaps my future self is still waiting for it.

524.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004870_VENAS
524.description: The moment she can let go and walk unto the end...

525.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004880_VENAS
525.description: Safe in the knowledge that man will find his own way.

526.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004890_VENAS
526.description: You, who are our future... Tell me this and tell me true.

527.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004900_VENAS
527.description: Has your journey been good? Has it been worthwhile?

529.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004920_GALENE
529.description: My observation subject was rather irritable, and it took a while to settle it down...

530.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004930_VENAS
530.description: No need to apologize─your work takes precedence. Besides, we had a pleasant conversation in the meantime.

531.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004940_GALENE
531.description: You're too kind. Now then, I'm told you wished to ask me some questions?

532.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004950_VENAS
532.description: Indeed. I've an interest in one of Hermes's creations─Meteion. You witnessed a host of them take flight, yes?

533.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004960_GALENE
533.description: Ohhh, that! Yes! Yes, I did!

534.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004970_GALENE
534.description: 'Twas in the dark of the morn. I'd left the Thalassai after nocturnal observation.

535.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004980_GALENE
535.description: As I walked along, I spied a bright light climbing high into the southeastern skies. Then, in an instant, it was gone─like a shooting star, only rising rather than falling.

536.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_004990_GALENE
536.description: But then another shot up. Then another, and another. Intrigued, I made my way to the edge to investigate.

537.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005000_GALENE
537.description: And who should I spy on an isle to the south but Hermes and Meteion─the Meteia, rather.

538.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005010_GALENE
538.description: There were lots of them, and I realized they must be the shooting stars that I'd seen!

539.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005020_VENAS
539.description: A dazzling spectacle indeed... Have you spoken with Hermes about this?

540.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005030_GALENE
540.description: Oh, yes. The sight left such an impression on me that I approached him about his mystery project the very next day.

541.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005040_GALENE
541.description: Alas, he said that he couldn't reveal anything just yet─that he needed to conduct further tests.

542.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005050_GALENE
542.description: It shouldn't be long now, though.

543.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005060_GALENE
543.description: He often returns to that isle, and I have a feeling he's nearing a breakthrough.

544.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005070_VENAS
544.description: Splendid. We are likewise eager for the details.

545.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005080_VENAS
545.description: Well, that is all we wished to ask. Thank you for taking the time to indulge our curiosity.

546.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005090_GALENE
546.description: You're very welcome. It's always a pleasure to speak with other inquisitive souls.

547.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005100_GALENE
547.description: Oh, and will you be descending now? If so, I shall link the doors for you.

549.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005120_VENAS
549.description: 'Twas my intent to finish it, but clearly I underestimated you.

550.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005130_VENAS
550.description: One would think I never learn. I made the same mistake with Azem when we first sparred. Despite being less than half my age, his strength was astounding.

551.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005140_VENAS
551.description: One would think I never learn. I made the same mistake with Azem when we first sparred. Despite being less than half my age, her strength was astounding.

552.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005150_VENAS
552.description: As is yours. 'Tis plain you have weathered considerable hardship. Far more, even, than your tales would suggest.

553.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005160_VENAS
553.description: It seems we have both learned much on our journeys.

554.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005170_VENAS
554.description: Well now, I daresay he has warmed to you.

555.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005180_VENAS
555.description: A boon to be sure. He never forgets his favorites, and is ever eager to come to their aid.

556.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005190_VENAS
556.description: Quite a small place, lacking even the most basic equipment.

557.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005200_VENAS
557.description: The present may yield no clues, but we may yet try perusing the past. Have you done this before?

558.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005210_VENAS
558.description: So you cannot control the power freely. Worry not, I shall assist you.

560.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005230_VENAS
560.description: There are two ways to see the past.

561.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005240_VENAS
561.description: The first entails peering through the walls of the soul in the moment a subject is recalling a memory.

562.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005250_VENAS
562.description: The second requires no subject, and is instead a process of piecing together an event from ripples left in the ambient aether.

563.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005260_VENAS
563.description: As memories are etched upon the aether of the soul, so too are they etched upon the aether of the world. In this way can history be preserved.

564.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005270_VENAS
564.description: Such memories are given to fading, however, and can prove challenging to visit.

565.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005280_VENAS
565.description: But come, let us try. Close your eyes.

566.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005290_METEION
566.description: All units fully functional and proceeding on course towards their respective stars.

567.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005300_METEION
567.description: Estimated time to completion of survey is one hundred and eight cycles.

568.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005310_METEION
568.description: End of status report. Severing connection with shared consciousness.

569.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005320_METEION
569.description: Did you hear that, Hermes? All is well!

571.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005340_HERMES
571.description: Yes, good tidings at long last...

572.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005350_HERMES
572.description: Every step of the way, I've been reminded how little we understand creation. How the universe defies imagination.

573.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005360_METEION
573.description: But soon we won't need to speculate. We'll know the answers─what others live for!

574.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005370_HERMES
574.description: Indeed... And we'll owe it all to you and your sisters.

576.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005390_METEION
576.description: I wonder... What answers we will get?

577.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005400_HERMES
577.description: Whatever intelligent beings that exist out there are bound to be vastly different from us.

578.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005410_HERMES
578.description: Diverse in form and culture. Possessed of unique ways of thinking.

579.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005420_HERMES
579.description: Their conception of life and its purpose will be no exception. Completely and utterly unlike ours.

582.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005450_HERMES
582.description: Yet whatever answers we receive, I will not dismiss them out of hand. No, I will think earnestly on them all.

583.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005460_HERMES
583.description: Then I will share them with our people, that together we may contemplate our own existence.

584.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005470_HERMES
584.description: Perhaps then our star will become a better place─not only for man, but for all life.

585.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005480_HERMES
585.description: Meteion. Though I gave you wings to soar the heavens, I did not teach you how to walk the earth. So loath was I to bind another living being.

586.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005490_HERMES
586.description: In the course of your long journey, you will learn from those you meet. Learn to walk and run and so much more.

587.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005500_HERMES
587.description: And when you return, older and wiser, we will have a celebration to mark your homecoming and coming of age both.

588.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005510_METEION
588.description: Will there be apples? Covered in syrup?

589.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005520_HERMES
589.description: And how are you supposed to eat them?

592.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005550_HERMES
592.description: Yes. Upon your return, I will gift you a beautiful flower.

595.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_A9_000_001_NONE_VOICE
595.description: Hermes wouldn't wish for the Final Days.

596.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_A9_000_002_NONE_VOICE
596.description: Hermes is a gentle soul. And yet...

597.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_A9_000_003_NONE_VOICE
597.description: I couldn't say just by this moment alone.

599.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005580_VENAS
599.description: As we had suspected, the two are somehow involved. Yet 'tis difficult to believe that they would deliberately seek to end all life.

600.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005590_VENAS
600.description: I understand. He is a gentle soul, and well intentioned. Yet it does not take ill intent to beget ill.

601.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005600_VENAS
601.description: We must consider the possibility that something may have gone awry. Perhaps it was oversight...or simply an accident.

602.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005610_VENAS
602.description: As you say, that was hardly conclusive. Yet based on what we witnessed, I find it difficult to believe that they would deliberately seek to end all life.

603.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005620_VENAS
603.description: Be that as it may, we cannot rule out the possibility that they will play a part in bringing about the Final Days. Perhaps unwittingly.

605.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005640_VENAS
605.description: I propose that we reveal your tale to Hermes himself.

606.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005650_VENAS
606.description: If he does not wish for the Final Days, as we believe, he may well join us in pursuing a solution.

607.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005660_VENAS
607.description: Then it is settled. Let us seek out our friend with all swiftness.

608.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005670_VENAS
608.description: 'Twould not do to let such a pure soul be blackened by tragedy.

609.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005680_HERMES
609.description: My apologies for keeping you waiting. I understand there is a matter you wish to discuss.

610.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005690_EMETSELCH
610.description: Aye, a matter of the utmost gravity...if one can suspend disbelief.

611.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005700_EMETSELCH
611.description: Go on, then. Tell him what you told us. Who you are and why you came.

613.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005720_VENAS
613.description: The phenomena observed during these star-encompassing calamities is likely the product of a dynamis reaction.

614.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005730_VENAS
614.description: And none is more versed in the applications of this energy than you, Hermes.

615.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005740_VENAS
615.description: I must stress that we do not believe you would desire such destruction. We come not to lodge accusations, but to beg your wisdom.

616.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005750_VENAS
616.description: And so, distressing though the exercise may be, I ask that you share with us your opinion on the matter─on the assumption that our visitor's tale is true.

618.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005770_HERMES
618.description: As you say, the phenomena observed in the two calamities may both be attributed to dynamis.

619.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005780_HERMES
619.description: Of note is the difference in its effect. In the first Final Days, it warped creation magicks. In the second, it warped the people themselves.

620.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005790_HERMES
620.description: The key variable, I suspect, is the aetheric density of the men of each age.

621.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005800_HERMES
621.description: As you know, aether, in essence, negates dynamis.

622.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005810_HERMES
622.description: Harboring high concentrations of aether, we ancients cannot readily manipulate dynamis─nor be manipulated by it. Therefore, rather than our selves, the calamity affected our magicks.

623.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005820_HERMES
623.description: In contrast, having been sundered, the people of the future are composed of but a fraction of our aether.

624.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005830_HERMES
624.description: Thus are they susceptible to the influence of dynamis─and its transformative potential.

625.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005840_HERMES
625.description: But that would explain only the mechanism, not the cause... Though perhaps...

626.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005850_EMETSELCH
626.description: What is it? Even should it be a hypothesis, we would hear it.

627.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005860_HERMES
