627.description: Dynamis is an energy put in motion by feelings. Feelings for which there must first exist a source.

628.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005870_HERMES
628.description: A source to which the victims must be attuned─one that harbors the selfsame negative emotions. Elsewise, it could not be the agent of such extreme change.

629.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005880_VENAS
629.description: So it wasn't the stagnation of the celestial currents...

630.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005890_VENAS
630.description: Someone─or something─is instigating the star's demise.

631.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005900_EMETSELCH
631.description: So we've a villain on our hands after all... Any idea who or what it could be?

632.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005910_HERMES
632.description: The celestial currents comprise the outermost layer of the star's aether, encasing it like a protective sphere.

633.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005920_HERMES
633.description: According to your tale, 'twas where the currents were weakest that the phenomena first manifested.

634.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005930_HERMES
634.description: If the inciting factor came from without Etheirys, then its effects would first be seen in those locations.

636.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005950_METEION
636.description: Do not be alarmed─I mean you no harm.

637.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005960_METEION
637.description: I wish only to hear your words. Share your feelings. Know your thoughts.

640.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_005990_METEION
640.description: Executing scheduled task. Suspending individual self and connecting to shared consciousness.

643.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006020_METEION
643.description: It hurts, it hurts! It hurts!

644.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006030_METEION
644.description: So hot...so cold...so sad... I don't understand... Make it stop... Please, make it stop...

646.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006050_METEION
646.description: So scared...so lonely... The pain...it's too much...

650.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006090_HERMES
650.description: She has altered her aetheric density in order to blend in with her surroundings. An ability for avoiding confrontation.

651.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006100_HYTHLODAEUS
651.description: Most effective...frustratingly so. I can't see her either─not even a trace.

652.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006110_METEION
652.description: Stay away. Please. This is wrong. My mistake. So please...

654.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006130_VENAS
654.description: ...In your mind? No, we only heard her speak the instant before she vanished.

655.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006140_HERMES
655.description: Of course. When communicating without words, Meteion also employs dynamis.

656.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006150_HERMES
656.description: That would explain why you were able to hear her when we could not.

657.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006160_EMETSELCH
657.description: Then you are our best chance of finding her. Follow her voice, and try to track her down.

658.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006170_EMETSELCH
658.description: Hindered though we may be, let us split up and search as well.

660.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006190_EMETSELCH
660.description: Give chase. We shall herd her into the shelter.

664.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006230_METEION
664.description: I'm sorry, Hermes... I'm so sorry...

665.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006240_METEION
665.description: If someone can hear these words, then please...

667.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006260_METEION
667.description: Individual self suspended. Connection with shared consciousness stable.

668.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006270_METEION
668.description: Our survey is complete. We shall now report our findings.

669.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006280_METEION
669.description: All units safely arrived at their respective destinations. Seeking answers to Hermes's question, we attempted to make contact with the intelligent denizens of each star.

670.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006290_METEION
670.description: Results are as follows, in order of numerical code.

671.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006300_METEION
671.description: Hena: Traces of civilization found─structures believed to have served as domiciles. No extant life-forms detected.

672.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006310_METEION
672.description: Dyo: Ruined remnants of buildings scattered across star, surface of which is encased in ice. Presence of life could not be verified.

673.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006320_METEION
673.description: Tria: Evidence of large population centers akin to cities recovered. No extant life-forms found─only their lingering essence.

674.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006330_METEION
674.description: Tessera: Edifices surmised to be abandoned residences found. No extant life-forms detected. Deadly plague or extreme environmental degradation likely to have led to mass extinction.

676.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006350_METEION
676.description: Okto: Star found in state of violent conflict. Contact successfully made with inhabitants, but deployment of weapons of mass destruction resulted in total annihilation of local population shortly thereafter.

677.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006360_METEION
677.description: Ennea: Star is a barren desert. No identifiable flora found. Bones of living beings resembling men discovered beneath sands, but determination regarding their intelligence inconclusive.

678.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006370_EMETSELCH
678.description: Remind me, Hermes. What exactly was the question you entrusted to Meteion?

679.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006380_HERMES
679.description: I tasked her with asking what others live for. What gives their lives...meaning...

680.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006390_EMETSELCH
680.description: Did you consider what may happen if the premise of the question is flawed?

681.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006400_EMETSELCH
681.description: To be able to answer it, one must be living─and desire to continue doing so.

682.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006410_EMETSELCH
682.description: But if Meteion finds no living beings in the course of her journey...

683.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006420_EMETSELCH
683.description: Or none who desire to live, what then?

684.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006430_EMETSELCH
684.description: What answers would she derive from their silence?

686.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006450_VENAS
686.description: Meteion, enough. Suspend your mission and return hither at once.

687.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006460_METEION
687.description: Deka-pente: Local civilization once flourished under auspices of higher power. Said power later laid waste to civilization in fit of rage.

688.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006470_METEION
688.description: Upon revealing this to me, entity elected to self-terminate in lieu of providing answer to question. No other intelligent life-forms found.

689.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006480_EMETSELCH
689.description: Turning a deaf ear, are we?

690.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006490_EMETSELCH
690.description: We are taking Meteion back to Amaurot. As I understand, we will need her if we are to bring back all of her sisters.

693.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006520_HERMES
693.description: It isn't right, is it? It isn't right to turn away from the answer...even if the answer...is pain...

694.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006530_HERMES
694.description: Even if we aberrations must scream ourselves hoarse to be heard...

695.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006540_HERMES
695.description: Aye. Whatever answers we find, I will not dismiss them out of hand. These words I said to you...and I will hold myself to them.

696.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006550_EMETSELCH
696.description: What is the meaning of this!?

697.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006560_HERMES
697.description: You cannot take Meteion. Not until she has finished her report.

701.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006600_HERMES
701.description: I've no wish to fight. But this time, I cannot yield.

702.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006610_HERMES
702.description: Though the world may think me a mad, desperate fool, I will hold fast to my conviction.

704.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006630_EMETSELCH
704.description: It's over, Hermes. In the name of the Convocation, I hereby take Meteion into custody.

705.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006640_EMETSELCH
705.description: And setting aside the matter of your nomination, you will come with us, too. We require your knowledge to assess and resolve the situation.

707.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006660_HERMES
707.description: Meteion... I'm so sorry... Would that I could have listened to your report in full...

708.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006670_HERMES
708.description: Reflected upon its meaning and conveyed it to others─that they might reconsider their chosen course...

709.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006680_HERMES
709.description: But I have failed, and that wish will never be realized. However...

710.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006690_HERMES
710.description: Ere our fates become the province of others, I bid you tell me...just one thing.

711.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006700_HERMES
711.description: Was there happiness in those distant stars?

712.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006710_HERMES
712.description: Was there a reason for living?

713.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006720_METEION
713.description: We conducted our search as per your instructions.

714.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006730_METEION
714.description: We scoured historical records. Communed with the spirits of the deceased.

715.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006740_METEION
715.description: Heard the final testaments of the dying. Welcomed their shadowed hearts into our own.

716.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006750_METEION
716.description: One race had striven to create a world bereft of animosity.

717.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006760_METEION
717.description: They renounced relationships to avoid interpersonal strife, and in so doing brought about societal collapse.

718.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006770_METEION
718.description: One race had renounced war and devoted itself to the enrichment of its people.

719.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006780_METEION
719.description: They were conquered. Though they destroyed the enemy in reprisal, they could not regain their former glory.

720.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006790_METEION
720.description: One race had concluded that finite time was the root of all woes. Aspiring to shatter its shackles, they went in search of infinity.

721.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006800_METEION
721.description: They discovered nothing is infinite, and that neither time or death can be cheated. Disillusioned, they gave up on the future─and themselves.

722.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006810_METEION
722.description: One race had discarded all things that gave rise to sorrow, hoping to have only joy.

723.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006820_METEION
723.description: They found joy lost its savor in the absence of sorrow, and lost their will to live.

724.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006830_METEION
724.description: Though worlds apart, these peoples shared a belief. The belief that they had tried their best.

725.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006840_METEION
725.description: That they had tried to fulfill their potential, with every step and success.

726.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006850_METEION
726.description: In the course of which they learned the truth.

727.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006860_METEION
727.description: That they would never be free of fear and sorrow, anger and despair─of loneliness─so long as they yet lived.

728.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006870_METEION
728.description: Even now, their souls cry out for oblivion. And to this song of anguish, I lend my voice. We lend our voice.

729.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006880_METEION
729.description: O beloved mankind, shimmering jewels of beautiful Etheirys... Rejoice, for we will free you from the cruel yoke of existence.

730.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006890_METEION
730.description: There is no need to struggle in vain, for in nihility awaits salvation. You will know peace and serenity...and it will be beautiful.

731.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006900_METEION
731.description: We will make our nest at the edge of the universe, and there in the dark of dead worlds hoard sorrow and suffering.

732.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006910_METEION
732.description: There we will sing, our chorus ever louder and ever clearer, that our song may reach even this aether-shrouded star.

733.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006920_METEION
733.description: Such is the answer we have found in the stars. Such is the gift we now offer to Etheirys.

734.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006930_EMETSELCH
734.description: Who are you to decide our fate? To decree we live or die?

735.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006940_EMETSELCH
735.description: Have you lost your mind!? You heard what she said! She means to destroy us all, yet you'd still take her side!?

736.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006950_HERMES
736.description: In the name of the star, we have discarded those creations that we deemed flawed.

737.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006960_HERMES
737.description: If we ourselves are flawed, does it not stand to reason that we too should be discarded?

738.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006970_EMETSELCH
738.description: That is sophistry and you know it!

739.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006980_HERMES
739.description: Perhaps it is. Perhaps I am wrong. But who is to say that you are right?

740.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_006990_HERMES
740.description: Let us settle this with a determination.

741.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007000_HERMES
741.description: In my authority as chief overseer of Elpis, I will make a judgment on man's fitness to exist.

742.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007010_HERMES
742.description: If he can learn to value all life and retain his will to live, even should his end be justified, he will surely find a way to avert his demise.

743.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007020_HERMES
743.description: If not, he will perish from the star.

744.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007030_HERMES
744.description: As with all determinations, provisions must be made to ensure fairness.

746.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007050_KAIROS
746.description: (-Kairos-)Memory reconfiguration system Kairos activated. Awaiting instruction.

747.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007060_HERMES
747.description: Command: universal memory alteration. Target area: Ktisis Hyperboreia.

748.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007070_HERMES
748.description: Starting point: arrival of Emet-Selch of the Convocation at Propylaion. End point: the present.

749.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007080_HERMES
749.description: Erase the memories of all events, and replace with a vague recollection of the following:

750.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007090_HERMES
750.description: I was here, preparing to demonstrate the functionality of Kairos to Emet-Selch and Hythlodaeus.

751.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007100_HERMES
751.description: Meteion's shared consciousness became unstable. She and her sisters could not sustain their existence, and all dissipated with a burst.

752.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007110_HERMES
752.description: The resultant shockwave accidentally triggered Kairos, which erased several days of memories from all present. Execute.

753.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007120_KAIROS
753.description: (-Kairos-)Command acknowledged. Initializing... Three processes remaining to execution.

754.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007130_HYTHLODAEUS
754.description: Bravo. I daresay one would be hard-pressed to make it fairer...

755.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007140_HYTHLODAEUS
755.description: Everything that you told us, everything that has happened─the fact we've even met... It will all be gone.

756.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007150_HERMES
756.description: Go, Meteion. To the edge of the universe, where none can reach you.

757.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007160_METEION
757.description: Hermes. Won't you come with me? If you were to shed your flesh, I should be able to carry you.

759.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007170_HERMES
759.description: I will remain. As a man, I will oppose the oblivion you bring.

760.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007180_METEION
760.description: Silly fool... Had you said yes, I would've granted you the gentlest end.

767.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007240_KAIROS
767.description: (-Kairos-)First process complete. Two remaining to execution of memory reconfiguration.

768.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007250_HYTHLODAEUS
768.description: As if we needed more pressure...

769.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007260_HYTHLODAEUS
769.description: No matter what, you cannot forget what happened today. For it is the key to saving your future─your world.

770.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007270_HYTHLODAEUS
770.description: This fight is our fight; what comes after, our problem to contend with. Not yours.

771.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007280_HYTHLODAEUS
771.description: No, your own struggle awaits. And no one else can take your place.

772.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007290_HYTHLODAEUS
772.description: You must flee this place with your memories intact─and I will see that you do!

774.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007310_HYTHLODAEUS
774.description: There you are, my little confluence.

778.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007350_VENAS
778.description: You may elude us this day, but not forever!

780.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007370_KAIROS
780.description: (-Kairos-)Second process complete. One remaining to execution.

782.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007390_HYTHLODAEUS
782.description: Listen well. Beyond lies a spatial confluence that connects the interior sections of this building.

783.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007400_HYTHLODAEUS
783.description: I will destroy the confluence and force open a way outside. When I do, you must jump through.

784.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007410_HERMES
784.description: I cannot tell you how sorry I am...

785.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007420_HERMES
785.description: ...But neither can I let you escape!

788.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007450_HERMES
788.description: What? But how? I thought the confluence was over...

789.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007460_HYTHLODAEUS
789.description: Over there? Yes, we were rather hoping you would.

790.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007470_EMETSELCH
790.description: It was never anywhere but where it is now.

791.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007480_EMETSELCH
791.description: The instant those two began making their way towards nothing, 'twas clear the plan was a diversion.

792.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007490_HYTHLODAEUS
792.description: I'm quite incapable of destroying a confluence, I must confess.

793.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007500_EMETSELCH
793.description: A gambit brazen beyond words. Though we've grown accustomed to reckless improvision due to the antics of an incorrigible associate.

794.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007510_EMETSELCH
794.description: Though in the case of certain present company, “incorrigible” is an understatement.

795.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007520_EMETSELCH
795.description: Honestly, I'm beginning to suspect it's a requirement for every Azem.

797.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007540_EMETSELCH
797.description: Even now, I do not believe your tale. I would not suffer us to walk such a wretched path.

798.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007550_EMETSELCH
798.description: Still, if it must be said...

799.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007560_EMETSELCH
799.description: Do not squander it. The legacy I leave you.

800.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007570_KAIROS
800.description: (-Kairos-)Final process complete. Executing universal memory alteration.

803.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007600_VENAS
803.description: I'm fine. Just a little tired.

805.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007620_VENAS
805.description: Are we the only ones left who see beauty in the world─in life?

806.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007630_VENAS
806.description: Are the stars above no more than husks of fallen civilizations?

808.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007650_VENAS
808.description: ...I feel her. Though she is unimaginably distant, I feel Meteion's presence─and the place whereto we must go.

809.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007660_VENAS
809.description: Ere she made good her escape, I placed an enchantment upon her. One which allows us to follow her trail.

810.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007670_VENAS
810.description: She has already left the outermost bounds of Etheirys, and continues on her way. Given the vastness of the universe, it will still be no easy feat to track her down.

811.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007680_VENAS
811.description: But thanks to Emet-Selch and Hythlodaeus, all is not lost. We remember.

812.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007690_VENAS
812.description: So long as we remember, our fates remain ours to shape.

814.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_A10_000_001_NONE_VOICE
814.description: What became of the others, I wonder...

816.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007700_VENAS
816.description: I'd like to know too. Let us ascertain the situation at Ktisis Hyperboreia, where they should still be.

817.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007710_VENAS
817.description: What indeed. Let us begin by ascertaining the situation at Ktisis Hyperboreia, where the others should still be.

818.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007720_VENAS
818.description: Given the likely state of their memories, however, 'twould be imprudent for us to approach them directly. In which case...

819.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007730_VENAS
819.description: I am sorry, my friend. I've asked much of you this day, but may I trouble you one last time?

820.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007740_VENAS
820.description: Argos will investigate in our stead. We will share in his consciousness, and see and hear as if we were with him.

821.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007750_VENAS
821.description: Now, close your eyes and open your mind...

823.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007770_EMETSELCH
823.description: Unharmed? There is a gaping hole in my memories. I can scarcely remember arriving here in Elpis...

825.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007790_HERMES
825.description: I was preparing to demonstrate the functionality of Kairos to our guests.

826.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007800_HERMES
826.description: But Meteion...her shared consciousness became unstable. And she...she...

827.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007810_HYPERBOREIASTAFF
827.description: So that's what prompted the state of alert.

828.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007820_HYPERBOREIASTAFF
828.description: And when you went to investigate, you were caught in Kairos's accidental operation.

829.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007830_EMETSELCH
829.description: So it would seem... It's all a blur to me.

830.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007840_HYPERBOREIASTAFF
830.description: Such an unfortunate accident... Oh, and what of Venat and your other companion? You went inside together, as I recall.

832.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007860_HYTHLODAEUS
832.description: If Venat was with us, I have no recollection of it.

833.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007870_HYTHLODAEUS
833.description: But that there is her familiar, is it not? The fellow seems happy enough, so I think it safe to assume his mistress is well.

834.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007880_HYTHLODAEUS
834.description: I haven't the slightest notion who this other companion might be, however...

835.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007890_HYPERBOREIASTAFF
835.description: Ah, well, that individual struck me as a bit...different, for want of a better word.

836.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007900_HYPERBOREIASTAFF
836.description: Perhaps it wasn't actually a person, but some manner of creation.

837.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007910_HYTHLODAEUS
837.description: Curious... I must ask Venat about it when next we meet.

838.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007920_EMETSELCH
838.description: Yes, yes, you do that. Now, if we may tend to Hermes? Whatever this Meteion did, it seems he bore the brunt of it.

839.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007930_EMETSELCH
839.description: Once you are fit to travel, you will return with us to Amaurot. We need to make certain there are no other ill effects.

840.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007940_EMETSELCH
840.description: Also─I am here on business of the Fourteen. We've already had the conversation, like as not, but since your toy wiped my memory, we'll have to have it again.

841.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007950_HERMES
841.description: Yes, of course. As you see fit.

842.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007960_HYTHLODAEUS
842.description: This Kairos─it manipulates memories through the emission of aetheric waves, correct?

843.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007970_HYTHLODAEUS
843.description: There is a theory which holds that memories scoured by blasts of aether are restored when the soul is cleansed in the Underworld.

844.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007980_HYTHLODAEUS
844.description: If true, then perhaps when our time comes to return to the star, we shall remember these few days we have lost.

845.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_007990_EMETSELCH
845.description: I doubt aught of interest occurred. Look forward to the revelation if you like, but I should prefer to reminisce on more meaningful moments.

846.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008000_VENAS
846.description: Let us rest. If only for a while.

847.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008010_VENAS
847.description: After all, you and I... We still have a long, long way to go.

848.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008020_VENAS
848.description: So...it is within. The portal that brought you hither...and will take you home.

850.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_A11_000_001_NONE_VOICE
850.description: Yes. This is where we part ways.

851.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_A11_000_002_NONE_VOICE
851.description: Perhaps I should stay and help...

852.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008030_VENAS
852.description: May you and yours emerge triumphant.

853.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008040_VENAS
853.description: Make use of the knowledge you have gained, that your days in Elpis and our friends' sacrifice be not in vain.

854.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008050_VENAS
854.description: I appreciate your sentiment, I truly do, but 'tis a very long game that we must now play.

855.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008060_VENAS
855.description: And while you have maintained a stable presence here thus far, there are dangers in lingering overlong.

856.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008070_VENAS
856.description: No, you must return to your own battlefield. Make use of the knowledge you have attained, that your days here and our friends' sacrifice be not in vain.

857.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008080_VENAS
857.description: With Meteion free to pursue her designs, 'tis only a matter of time until the Final Days are upon us.

858.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008090_VENAS
858.description: We must be ready. From fortifying our defenses to securing our escape, there is much to be done.

859.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008100_VENAS
859.description: In spite of this, we cannot allow the report that set this calamity in motion to become common knowledge. Were the masses to learn the fates of the other stars, I fear the situation would spiral out of our control.

860.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008110_VENAS
860.description: I must carefully consider who can be trusted, and bring them into the fold.

861.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008120_VENAS
861.description: Ordinarily, I wouldn't hesitate to call upon the Fourteen. However, it was the desire for a fair determination that drove Hermes to attempt to erase our memories; were he made aware of his actions, there is no telling whether he would remain a friend or become a foe.

862.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008130_VENAS
862.description: Alternately, we might try to alienate him from the Convocation. Yet in doing so, we would deprive ourselves of a brilliant mind who would be invaluable in the crises to come.

863.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008140_VENAS
863.description: Quite the dilemma... Which is why I must work independently of the Convocation.

864.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008150_VENAS
864.description: Regardless of how we proceed, if we are to permanently avert the Final Days, we must be equal to Hermes's challenge. We must prove that mankind is worthy to exist.

865.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008160_VENAS
865.description: And this hinges, I think, on how we confront the all-consuming despair that accompanies a senseless and seemingly inevitable end.

866.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008170_VENAS
866.description: Bewildered and divided, we would perish like the peoples of those celestial ruins.

867.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008180_VENAS
867.description: We could not hope to survive the Final Days, much less take the battle to Meteion at her nest.

868.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008190_VENAS
868.description: We must find a way to defeat despair. To unite and prepare as many as possible for the struggle ahead.

869.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008200_VENAS
869.description: Heavy will weigh the burden of guiding this legion of souls...

870.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008210_VENAS
870.description: Yet I have faith in mankind's potential. As long as he believes in himself, there is naught he cannot achieve. So I will not give up on him. On us.

871.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008220_VENAS
871.description: You may find your world to be very different. Or perhaps the erasure of our friends' memories has sown the seeds of a conjunction between us.

872.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008230_VENAS
872.description: We cannot know until the moment is at hand. So shall I strive to do my best, taking naught for granted as I walk my path.

873.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008240_VENAS
873.description: And I pray you walk with me to the end.

874.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008250_VENAS
874.description: As you move forward, so too will I. As will all resolved to fight for the morrow.

875.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008260_VENAS
875.description: And when mankind has found the strength to stand against despair...

876.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008270_VENAS
876.description: We shall silence the song of oblivion.

877.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008280_VENAS
877.description: She who sings it will learn our journey is far from over. This I promise.

878.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008290_VENAS
878.description: Fare you well, my light of the future. Till we meet again.

879.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008300_HERMES
879.description: From this day forth, I shall strive to bring honor to the seat of Fandaniel.

880.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008310_VENAS
880.description: Even now, I remember standing there. Locked in a moment where the sky is aflame.

881.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008320_VENAS
881.description: Where stars fall as tears, and screams darken the seas.

883.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008340_VENAS
883.description: Where terror twists magicks into abominations.

884.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008350_VENAS
884.description: Such is the lament of they who have gone before.

885.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008360_VENAS
885.description: The song of they who tried and failed to create a better world. The song of the end.

886.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008370_VENAS
886.description: That which hides at the edge of the universe is no longer hope's creation.

888.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008390_VENAS
888.description: That day, mankind saw half of its number sacrificed to bring forth Zodiark.

889.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008400_VENAS
889.description: And covering the star in a shroud of aether, we forestalled the Final Days.

891.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008420_VENAS
891.description: We wept for innocence lost. Wailed for death inevitable.

892.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008430_VENAS
892.description: A reality too terrible to bear...

893.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008440_VENAS
893.description: And for too many, who sought comfort in gilded memories of joyful days and tranquil nights.

894.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008450_ANCIENTMEMORYA
894.description: This is all wrong... Why must we suffer so?

895.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008460_ANCIENTMEMORYB
895.description: It needn't be like this. No, there must be a way to restore things to the way they were. To reclaim the perfect paradise we once had.

896.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008470_VENAS
896.description: No, my friends. Suffering exists, and we cannot pretend otherwise.

897.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008480_VENAS
897.description: No civilization, however great, could eliminate it. If we would live, we must accept it as our constant companion.

898.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008490_VENAS
898.description: Let us not seek to forget this tragedy. Let us carry it in our hearts, that we may grow stronger and know true happiness.

899.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008500_ANCIENTMEMORYA
899.description: We can't accept it! We <hex:021A020203>won't<hex:021A020103> accept it! It will be ours again─a world free of sorrow!

900.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008510_VENAS
900.description: No, it will not, for there has ever been sorrow. Mankind was but spared its biting sting for a time.

901.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008520_VENAS
901.description: So please, open your eyes. To try and reclaim those lives we lost by sacrificing yet more isn't wisdom. It is weakness.

902.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008530_VENAS
902.description: No paradise is without its shadows. If we cannot accept this truth and learn from our pain, then our plight shall be repeated.

903.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008540_ANCIENTMEMORYB
903.description: O mighty Zodiark, god born of our boundless faith! We bid you hear our prayer!

904.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008550_ANCIENTMEMORYB
904.description: Accept this offering of lives, and deliver unto us the lives we once had. Deliver unto us the days of old...

905.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008560_ANCIENTMEMORYB
905.description: The days when the star was a font of love, and we knew naught but bliss!

906.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008570_ANCIENTMEMORYA
906.description: You would destroy it? Our beautiful world?

907.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008580_VENAS
907.description: Lands that stretched on forever. Skies one could drown in. The heartbeat of nature, silent yet strong.

908.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008590_VENAS
908.description: And amidst it all a people. Beacons of light and life. Laughter that warmed my heart like naught else before.

909.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008600_VENAS
909.description: They are my meaning and my purpose. My love.

910.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008610_VENAS
910.description: In spite of...or perhaps because of this, I choose to believe.

911.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008620_VENAS
911.description: In mankind's potential. In his ability to find a way forward.

912.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008630_VENAS
912.description: So let there be no way back. From that temptation I sunder us.

913.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008640_VENAS
913.description: No more shall man have wings to bear him to paradise.

915.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008660_VENAS
915.description: All is excruciating pain. I breathe fire and torment.

916.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008670_VENAS
916.description: I birth a world of suffering to mire and plague.

917.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008680_VENAS
917.description: In one fleeting moment, lives come and go. Ever moving towards the unknown.

918.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008690_VENAS
918.description: And in that fleeting moment, they cry for the answer to the question:

919.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008700_VENAS
919.description: Why, given life, are they meant to suffer. To die...

920.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008710_VENAS
920.description: As fragmented, imperfect beings, yours is a never-ending quest.

921.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008720_VENAS
921.description: A quest to find your purpose, knowing your end is assured.

922.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008730_VENAS
922.description: To find the strength to continue, when all strength has left you.

923.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008740_VENAS
923.description: To find joy, even as darkness descends...

925.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008760_HYDAELYN
925.description: A conjunction has begun to form; an intertwining of your time and mine.

926.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008770_HYDAELYN
926.description: When you truly understand what is at stake, and your journey has prepared you to surmount the insurmountable...

927.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06004_008780_HYDAELYN
927.description: Then shall I honor the promise made in another time. Another age.
